ModMetaData.name: CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Module - Tactics
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Combat-time weapon-choice enhancements for the Combat Extended + Simple Sidearms combination. Installing the mod turns them on; every feature has its own settings toggle.
- Reload-abort when threatened: a pawn mid-reload with a hostile in effective range swaps to a loaded carried weapon instead of finishing the reload (player-ordered reloads are never interrupted). - Target-aware weapon choice: when drawing a gun against a target, the currently-loaded ammo's effectiveness against THAT target counts (penetration vs armor, EMP vs mechs). Never switches or reloads ammo. - Armor-aware melee choice: blunt weapons against armor, fast blades against flesh. - Ammo-depth tiebreak: when two carried guns rank about equally, prefer the one with deeper ammo reserves. - Forced-weapon dry fall-through (OFF by default — it overrides your explicit forced-weapon choice): a pawn forced onto a weapon that is completely out of ammo temporarily uses normal selection; the forced weapon resumes the moment ammo is available.
Requires the CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Patch.
